title: If it isn't written down, it didn't happen.

slides.label: Property operations
slides.title: If it isn't written down, it didn't happen.

slides.label: 01 · Property care
slides.title: Every job, with photos.
slides.body: A work order for each repair, with before and after photos and the date it was done.

slides.label: 02 · Trades & vendors
slides.title: One vendor list.
slides.body: Who you call for what, their rates, and their paperwork on file. Not scattered across phones.

slides.label: 03 · Billing & invoicing
slides.title: Every invoice matched to the work.
slides.body: If a bill can't be tied to a work order, it doesn't get paid until it can.

slides.label: 04 · Project management
slides.title: A timeline for every project.
slides.body: Start date, milestones, who's responsible, and what's holding it up.

slides.label: 05 · Documentation
slides.title: One place for all of it.
slides.body: When someone asks what happened at a property, the answer takes a minute, not a week.

slides.label: Free checklist
slides.title: Want the property file checklist?
slides.body: Comment ESTATE and we'll DM you the checklist we use to set up every property file.

caption:
If it isn't written down, it didn't happen.

1. A work order for every job, with before and after photos
2. One vendor list with rates and paperwork
3. Every invoice matched to the work it pays for
4. A timeline for every project
5. One place where all of it lives
